description: This file contains benchmark tests for the Abseil C++ library's time internal components, including date calculations, timezone loading, and time formatting/parsing functions.

methods.name: BM_Difference_Days
methods.description: Benchmark for calculating difference in days between two civil days.

methods.name: BM_Step_Days
methods.description: Benchmark for incrementing a civil day.

methods.name: BM_GetWeekday
methods.description: Benchmark for getting the weekday of a civil day.

methods.name: BM_NextWeekday
methods.description: Benchmark for computing the next specified weekday.

methods.name: BM_PrevWeekday
methods.description: Benchmark for computing the previous specified weekday.

methods.description: Benchmark for loading UTC timezone first.

methods.name: BM_Zone_LoadUTCTimeZoneLast

methods.name: BM_Zone_LoadAllTimeZonesCached
